documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Intimation Of Exercise Of Options By The Eligible Employee Of The Company

analysis.summary: Shyam Metalics reported strong Q2 FY27 financial results with a 33.4% year-on-year revenue growth and significant expansion in downstream operations. Management emphasized their 'Vision 2031' strategy, focusing on integrated multi-metal production, raw material security, and value-added product segments like stainless steel and auto steel. The company maintains a disciplined capital allocation policy, funding ongoing projects primarily through internal accruals while keeping debt levels modest. Looking ahead, management plans to stabilize newly commissioned facilities and continue scaling up high-value product lines. Shyam Metalics reported a 33.4% year-on-year increase in revenue for Q2 FY27, driven by its integrated multi-metal production model.

guidance.claim: The company targets an overall EBITDA margin of 14.5% to 16% in the future.
guidance.quote: We would like to take it our overall business to 16%, 15% EBITDA level. I'm talking about 14.5% plus.

guidance.claim: Management expects the stainless steel business to contribute approximately INR1,100 crores EBITDA and the SBQ business to contribute INR1,000 crores EBITDA by FY31.
guidance.quote: By FY31, we expect this business to contribute approximately INR1,100 crores EBITDA from stainless steel and INR1,000 crores EBITDA from SBQ business, respectively.

guidance.claim: The company targets an RoE of 16% and RoCE of 24% by 2031.
guidance.quote: We continue to target RoE of 16% and RoCE of 24% by 2031.

guidance.claim: The company targets revenue of over Rs 42,500 crore by FY31.
Management projects an EBITDA of approximately Rs 6,600 crore by FY31.
The company expects a 16% Return on Equity and 24% Return on Capital Employed by FY31.
Management stated a long-term EBITDA margin aspiration of around 14% to 15%.
guidance.quote: Even at this scale, our long-term EBITDA margin aspiration of around 14% to 15% remain very conservative considering that we are already operating at close to 13% to 14% EBITDA margin with several high-value business yet to contribute.

guidance.claim: Management remains confident of delivering a 600 to 700 basis point improvement in return on equity and return on capital by 2031.
guidance.quote: We remain confident of delivering a 600 to 700 basis point improvement in return on equity and return on capital by 2031, supported by higher utilization, richer value-added product portfolio and increasing contributions from our downstream businesses.

demand_outlook.claim: Global steel demand is projected to be flat in 2026, with 1.7% growth in 2027, while Indian demand is expected to increase by 7.9% in 2026 and 8% in 2027.
demand_outlook.quote: The World Steel Association October outlook projected broadly flat global steel demand in 2026, followed by 1.7% growth in 2027. India remains the major source of growth with the demand expected to increase 7.9% in 2026 and 8% in 2027.

demand_outlook.claim: Medium-to-long term prospects for the metal industry look extremely constructive and positive.
demand_outlook.quote: However, medium-to-long term look extremely constructive and positive, supported by infrastructure spending, smart manufacturing growth, renewables and infra housing and all these sectors.

demand_outlook.claim: In India, demand continues to remain healthy driven by government-led infrastructure development and other sectors.
demand_outlook.quote: In India, demand continues to remain healthy, driven by the growth. And as we know, our country being a developing nation, the fast treasury growth of last 10 years has witnessed the growth across the sector by the government-led infrastructure development, railway modernization, urbanization, manufacturing expansion and increasing focus on domestic value addition.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that they continue to witness healthy demand across several product categories.
demand_outlook.quote: We continue to witness healthy demand across several product categories, enabling us to further strengthen our market position.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is investing INR2,700 crores in an expansion at the Odisha plant for stainless steel, scheduled for commissioning by March 2029.
capex_expansion.quote: Stainless steel represents our other significant opportunity where we are diversifying by investing INR2,700 crores expansion in our Odisha plant, with complete downstream processing capability together is scheduled both to be commissioned target by March 2029, including the SBQ plant.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to deploy the balance capex of approximately INR8,864 crores over the next 2 to 3 years.
capex_expansion.quote: The balance planned capex of approximately INR8,864 crores is expected to be deployed over the next 2 to 3 years, and which is also through our internal accrual, and which is also in line with the project execution timelines.

capex_expansion.claim: The company signed an MOU for a 9 MTPA steel complex in Maharashtra, to be executed in phases over 8 to 10 years.
capex_expansion.quote: See, our total business plan for Maharashtra for 9 million tons is going to be done in 8 to 10 years, one.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has incurred Rs 9,921 crore in capital expenditure since listing.
capex_expansion.quote: Since listing, the Company has incurred Capex of Rs. 9,921 crores, representing 53% of the total planned CAPEX of Rs.18,785 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company achieved an important milestone by starting the commissioning of additional capacity of aluminum facilities in Odisha.
capex_expansion.quote: We are recently -- we have recently achieved an important milestone by starting the commissioning of our additional capacity of aluminium facilities in Odisha, further strengthening our downstream aluminium capabilities.

capex_expansion.claim: The aluminum flat roll product projects remain on track for commissioning during the second quarter.
capex_expansion.quote: The aluminium flat roll product projects remain on track for commissioning during the second quarter.

capex_expansion.claim: The company incurred INR575 crores towards ongoing expansion projects during the quarter.
capex_expansion.quote: On the capital expenditure front, we incurred INR575 crores during this quarter towards our ongoing expansion project.

capex_expansion.claim: Balance capex of approximately INR9,580 crores is expected to be deployed over the next 3 to 4 years.
capex_expansion.quote: Going forward, the balance approximately INR9,580 crores of our announced capex is expected to be deployed over the next 3 to 4 years across our planned project.

capex_expansion.claim: The company successfully commissioned its color-coated plant in April 2026, increasing cold rolling capacity by 60% from 0.25 to 0.4 million tons.
capex_expansion.quote: We are pleased to share the successful commissioning of our color coated plant in April 2026, which increased our cold rolling capacity by 60% from 0.25 metric ton to 0.4 metric ton -- million ton.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported an operating EBITDA margin of 13.8% for Q2 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: The operating EBITDA margin expanded by 170 bps year-on-year basis to 13.8%.

margins_costs.claim: Captive power generation provides a significant cost advantage, with in-house power costing Rs 2.44 per unit compared to Rs 5-7 per unit for grid power.
margins_costs.quote: Cost of in-house power (₹2.44 Per Unit) is significantly less than grid power which costs ₹5-7 Per Unit

margins_costs.claim: Revenue grew by 23% year-on-year to approximately INR5,500 crores while EBITDA and PAT increased by 28% and 21% respectively.
margins_costs.quote: During Q1 FY27, the revenue grew by 23% year-on-year to approximately INR5,500 crores, while EBITDA and PAT also followed an increase by 28% and 21%, respectively.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin expanded by 100 basis points on a year-on-year basis.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin expanded by 100 basis points on a year-on-year basis, reflecting sustained operational efficiency on the back of cost optimization, improved product mix, benefiting from our integrated operations and focusing more on B2C and value-added product, innovation and values.

margins_costs.claim: Operating EBITDA stood at INR765 crores with an operating EBITDA margin of 14%.
margins_costs.quote: Similarly, our operating EBITDA stood at INR765 crores, with an operating EBITDA margin of 14%, supported by an improved product mix, stronger operational efficiency, better realization across key product categories.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax for the quarter stood at INR351 crores, reflecting a growth of 20.6% year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax for the quarter stood at INR351 crores, reflecting a growth of 20.6% on a year-on-year basis, and 12.6% on a quarter-on-quarter basis.

orders_capacity.claim: Total sales volume increased by 26% year-on-year to 15.49 lakh tons in Q2 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: The total sales volume increased by 26% on year-on basis to 15.49 lakh tons in quarter 2 of the current financial year

orders_capacity.claim: Management noted they have order bookings for almost close to more than 10 months from their existing foil plant.
orders_capacity.quote: We are already in the business. We have a lot of order booking. We have almost close to more than 10 months order bookings from our existing foil plant.

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintains a modest net debt of INR192 crores as of September 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: The net debt remained modest at INR192 crores, providing a flexibility to meet our investment requirement while maintaining the prudent leverage.

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintains a debt-to-equity ratio cap of 0.5x.
The company acquired a 26% equity stake in Emerge Green Power Private Limited during the quarter.
capital_allocation.quote: During the quarter, Shyam Metalics acquired 26% equity stake in Emerge Green Power Private Limited, which is constantly becoming an associate company of the company.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board has declared an interim dividend of INR1.8 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: We are also pleased to say that our Board has declared an interim dividend of INR1.8 per share.

capital_allocation.claim: The company intends to fund investments primarily through internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: We remain confident in funding this investment, primarily through internal accruals, supported by our strong cash generation and healthy balance sheet.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that raw material prices have increased following oil issues.
risks_headwinds.quote: The raw material prices have gone up. Everybody knows that. Every raw material after the oil issues and all, every prices there is there.

risks_headwinds.claim: Globally, the metal industry continues to witness volatility due to fluctuation in prices, trade flow, and geopolitical development.
risks_headwinds.quote: Globally, the metal industry continues to witness volatility due to the fluctuation in the prices, trade flow, geopolitical development.

management_commitments.quote: But I can tell you in next 2 years from now, we should be able to do more than 75%, close to 70% or 80% from value added

management_commitments.claim: Production from the Phutamura coal block is expected to start in July 2027.
Management expects the aluminum flat roll product projects to commission during the second quarter.
management_commitments.quote: The aluminium flat roll product projects remain on track for commissioning during the second quarter.

management_commitments.claim: The balance of approximately INR9,580 crores of announced capex is expected to be deployed over the next 3 to 4 years.
management_commitments.quote: Going forward, the balance approximately INR9,580 crores of our announced capex is expected to be deployed over the next 3 to 4 years across our planned project.
